info.title: XR5.0 LLM Engine API
info.description: API for interacting with document-aware LLM agents for different pilots

post.description:
Chat with AI workflow for specific pilot.
Uses LlamaIndex workflows for processing queries.

delete.description:
Clear chat history for the current user and their assigned pilot.
Admin users can specify a pilot parameter to clear history for a specific pilot.

This allows users to start fresh conversations without the context
of previous messages.

Args:
    pilot: Optional pilot override for admin users
    current_user: Current authenticated user information
    
Returns:
    dict: Success message with details about cleared history
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: For various error conditions

get.description:
Get enhanced overview of documents.

- Admins see all pilots
- Regular users see only their accessible pilots

Returns comprehensive information about pilots and their documents with metadata.
Uses MongoDB for efficient data retrieval instead of querying Pinecone.

Get documents for a specific pilot.

Users can only access pilots in their accessible set unless they are admin.

delete.description:
Delete all documents for a specific pilot (Admin only).

This will delete the entire namespace and all vectors within it.
WARNING: This operation is irreversible!

get.description:
Get documents for the current user's pilot.

For users with custom pilot permission only:
- Returns their custom pilot's documents if they've created one
- Returns 404 if they haven't created their custom pilot yet

For users with predefined pilot access:
- Returns their assigned pilot's documents

Serve source PDF for a collection_name when available.
Access is constrained to pilots the user can access.

delete.description:
Delete a specific document from a pilot's namespace.

Users can only delete documents from pilots they can access unless they are admin.
This will remove the document from both Pinecone vector store and MongoDB metadata.

Clean up empty namespaces (Admin only).

This will remove any namespaces that have no vectors.

post.description:
Reconcile MongoDB with Pinecone data (Admin only).

This treats Pinecone as the source of truth:
- Creates MongoDB documents for collections that exist in Pinecone but not MongoDB
- Removes stale MongoDB documents for collections that no longer exist in Pinecone

Args:
    pilot: Optional pilot ID to sync only specific pilot (e.g., "1", "6")

get.description:
Get dashboard documents summary for chat interface.

Returns pilot statistics that the Chat component uses to determine available pilots.
This endpoint is used by the frontend to populate pilot selection for admin users.

post.description: Upload and process a document with pilot-aware ingestion.

get.description:
List system prompts.
- Admins see all prompts
- Regular users see only prompts for pilots they have access to

schema.title: Response List System Prompts Api System Prompt All Get
Response List All Custom Pilots Api Custom Pilots Get

post.description:
Create a new custom pilot for the current user.

Users can only have one custom pilot. If they already have one, this will return an error.

get.description: Get the current user's custom pilot.

Get a specific custom pilot by ID.

Users can only view their own custom pilot unless they are admin.

put.description:
Update a custom pilot's name.

Users can only update their own custom pilot unless they are admin.

delete.description:
Delete a custom pilot and all its associated data.

This will:
1. Delete all documents from MongoDB
2. Delete all vectors from Pinecone
3. Delete the custom pilot record

WARNING: This operation is irreversible!

Users can only delete their own custom pilot unless they are admin.

get.description:
Get detailed statistics for a custom pilot.

Users can only view stats for their own custom pilot unless they are admin.

Serve an image file from MongoDB GridFS (extracted_images bucket).

Args:
    relative_path: Relative path like "{doc_id}/{filename}" or
                  "extracted_images/{doc_id}/{filename}"
                  Examples:
                  - "pilot-3_manual_123/IH_Liner_pic_0.png"
                  - "extracted_images/pilot-3_manual_123/IH_Liner_pic_0.png"

Returns:
    Image file

Examples:
    GET /api/images/pilot-3_manual_123/IH_Liner_pic_0.png
    GET /api/images/extracted_images/pilot-3_manual_123/IH_Liner_pic_0.png
